acceptanceCriteria: HUP, INT and TERM during the wrapper build stop the build and all owned descendants and return the corresponding nonzero signal status without launching tests.
The existing script/gate-affected-corvint_test.sh cases continue to pass, with a fixture proving build-path interruption.
body: Reviewed 0927631cee801f3c0b53d9bf1b6a28d1641d87cf..c204e926210374f06dcae61772f230b2509bf334 in corvint-v1-0040. Core installed 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456; Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.456. script/gate-affected-corvint.sh:56-57 runs the build synchronously while child is empty; child is assigned only at line 65 for corvint test. Reproduction: prepend a fake go that records its pid and sleeps 30s, launch the wrapper in an owned session, wait for the build pid marker, send SIGTERM to only the wrapper. After 500ms both wrapper and build remain alive. Expected: termination retires the owned build and descendants and exits 143 promptly. Actual: trap is deferred while the synchronous child runs; it has no tracked build to forward to. Fixture processes were killed by the reviewer after observation. Acceptance should inject termination during a real initialized build fixture and verify no build descendants survive.
title: gate-affected-corvint does not stop its build when the wrapper is terminated
